pretreatment: Si nano-wires (NWs) grown vertically by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) with a diameter of ~75 nm and an aspect ratio of 600 on Si substrates
evidence: Si (001) and Ge (001) wafers (p-type, 1 cm × 1 cm pieces) with resistivities of 1–5 Ω cm were used as substrates for the material characterization. Although nearly all depositions were carried out using the Si substrates, Ge substrates were needed for the compositional analysis (vide infra). Si nano-wires (NWs) grown vertically by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) with a diameter of ~75 nm and an aspect ratio of 600 on Si substrates were used to study coating conformality.
